note: Cardarine/GW501516. Stesso composto (C1) di 10.3390/pharmaceutics17020152, dove GW-1...GW-5 compaiono solo come riferimento (Table 2 e intervallo delle energie reticolari coincidono con quelli di questo articolo). Nessun CCDC ne' refcode nel testo. Eventi: DSC dei cinque polimorfi (fusioni, perdita di solvente residuo di GW-1 e di GW-5, picchi esotermici ad alta temperatura), stabilita' a 40 °C e 75% RH. Non sono eventi: solubilita', liofilizzazione (preparazione), energie. Incoerenze del testo: (1) l'acetonitrile (solvente di GW-1) non e' nell'elenco dei solventi dello screening; (2) il torsionale C9-C12-S2-C13 di GW-1 e' 72.3° nel testo (3.1.1, con «S1») e −164.5° nella Table 2 (72.4° e' il valore di GW-2 in tabella); (3) la solubilita' di GW-2 e' 105 µg/mL nei risultati ma «from 120 to 212 µg/mL for GW-2» nella frase sulla liofilizzazione (120 e' il valore di GW-3); (4) parametri di cella di GW-5: indicizzazione nel testo (V = 2203.46 Å3) e raffinamento nella Table 3 (V = 2200.82 Å3); (5) entalpie di Table 4 negative per eventi endotermici e identiche per eventi diversi (−40.81 per GW-1 a 142 °C e GW-2; −9.06 per GW-4 e per GW-5 a 115 °C); (6) il testo dice «thiadiazol» e «acetate» per il tiazolo e il carbossile del composto; (7) «hydroxyl···thiazole N-H···O» e «carbonyl···carbonyl O-H···O» nella sezione Hirshfeld. La struttura di GW-5 e' per gli autori «possibly incomplete» (solvente forse non localizzato).

motivi_hb.motivo: O-H···N hydrogen bonds (hydroxyl to thiazole ring)
motivi_hb.citazione: Strong O-H···N hydrogen bonds connect the hydroxyl group with the thiazole rings, which are completed by C-H···O interactions.

forme.citazione: The recrystallization process of GW501516 in acetonitrile yielded the formation of the starting polymorph which crystallized in the centrosymmetric monoclinic P21/c space group. Its asymmetric unit contains one molecule
forme.note: Polimorfo di partenza, maggioritario nel campione commerciale. Cella e T dalla Table 1 (colonna GW-1). Il DSC mostra un picco a 82 °C per «residual solvent left after recrystallization» (E1): la formula in Table 1 non ha solvente, ma il testo non dice «anidro»; per questo anidro presunto. Il testo (3.1.1) scrive «Oxygen atoms from acetate participate in these interactions» (acetato per il gruppo carbossilico). Nessun CCDC ne' refcode nel testo.

motivi_hb.motivo: unidirectional O-H···N hydrogen bonds (acetate group to thiadiazol ring)
motivi_hb.citazione: among which are strong unidirectional O-H···N hydrogen bonds between the acetate group and the thiadiazol ring (Figure 3b).

forme.citazione: The slow evaporation of GW501516 in a mixture of pentane and acetone yielded the formation of a new polymorph which crystallizes in the monoclinic crystal system (centrosymmetric P21/n space group) with one molecule in the asymmetric unit
forme.note: Il testo dice «Both samples are solvent free» per GW-2 e GW-3 (DSC): anidro. Cella e T dalla Table 1. Nessun CCDC ne' refcode nel testo.

motivi_hb.citazione: Strong hydroxyl···thiazole O-H···N bonds combined with C-H···O involving oxygen atoms of the acetate group and C-H···π contacts are involved in overall crystal stability (Figure 4b).

forme.citazione: The polymorph grown by recrystallization in isopropyl alcohol was established to crystallize in the C2/c monoclinic space group with one molecule in the asymmetric unit
forme.note: «Both samples are solvent free» (GW-2 e GW-3). Cella e T dalla Table 1. Differenza maggiore con GW-1: la rotazione dell'eterociclo centrale («the major variation between GW-1 and GW-3 is the rotation of the central heterocycle»).

motivi_hb.chi: carboxyl groups of the two molecules (A and B) of the dimer
motivi_hb.citazione: Mutual carboxyl···carboxyl O-H···O hydrogen bonds which form a R22(8) homosynthon are present in the dimer formation.

forme.citazione: The fourth analyzed and reported polymorph of GW501516, found in the starting sample, crystallizes in a non-centrosymmetric space group (namely Pca21 of the orthorhombic crystal system). In this case, the asymmetric unit is found as a dimer comprising two individual molecules (denoted with A and B suffixes).
forme.note: Polimorfo minoritario trovato come cristallo singolo nel campione commerciale e mai riprodotto per ricristallizzazione. Due molecole indipendenti (A e B) nell'unita' asimmetrica (Z' = 2). In Table 1: parametro di Flack 0.54(2) e b = 4.906 senza incertezza (come scritti). Cella e T dalla Table 1. Nessun CCDC ne' refcode nel testo.

motivi_hb.motivo: hydroxyl···thiazole O3B-H3B···N1A interactions within the asymmetric unit
motivi_hb.chi: hydroxyl group of molecule B and thiazole N of molecule A
motivi_hb.citazione: Within the asymmetric unit, the molecules are tightly bonded via hydroxyl···thiazole O3B-H3B···N1A interactions.

forme.citazione: It was found that this polymorph crystallizes centrosymmetrically in the triclinic P-1 space group with two individual molecules in the asymmetric unit (denoted with A and B suffixes, Figure 7a)
forme.note: Struttura risolta da dati di polvere (indicizzazione, Monte Carlo e Rietveld): nessun cristallo singolo adatto. Cella dalla Table 3 (raffinamento finale), senza T e con V = 2200.82 senza incertezza. Le etichette della tabella sono «A (°)» e «Β (°)» per alfa e beta (maiuscole rovinate dal PDF). Il testo (3.1.5) da' invece i parametri dell'indicizzazione: a = 4.9283, b = 21.2441, c = 21.2749 Å, α = 94.41, β = 96.34, γ = 92.84°, V = 2203.46 Å3 (nell'extra). Struttura che gli autori dicono possibilmente incompleta («a possibly incomplete crystal structure solving of GW-5»): «structural voids» (192.8 Å3, 8.8% della cella) e impronte di Hirshfeld che potrebbero indicare solvente non localizzato; il DSC mostra un endotermo a 115 °C per «disordered solvent». Tipo anidro presunto.

forme.citazione: The starting sample consists of a mixture of two polymorphs, namely GW-1 (which is found in the majority) and the minor phase (GW-4) which was selected for single-crystal diffraction analysis, but which was not reproduced further for another analysis.
forme.note: Il campione commerciale e' una miscela di due polimorfi: GW-1 in maggioranza, GW-4 in minoranza; proporzioni non date.

forme.citazione: For polymorphs GW-1 and GW-2, we tried to improve the solubility by means of a freeze-drying method (for the other polymorphs, we did not try because there was not enough sample material for this method). Polymorphs GW-1 and GW-2 were dissolved in a mixture of ethanol and water and the vials were left open for 24 h, during which a part of the solvent evaporated. Following this, they were exposed to a temperature of −55 °C for two days, after which they underwent lyophilization.
forme.note: Campione di GW-1 dopo dissoluzione in etanolo/acqua e liofilizzazione: la forma solida non e' caratterizzata (il testo non dice se resti GW-1).

citazioni: All five polymorphs exhibit similar thermal behavior at high temperatures and present two exothermic peaks, the first of which is between 270 and 290 °C (associated with degradation and oxidation) and the second between 360 and 370 °C (associated with decomposition and oxidation).

The measurement of DSC traces was undertaken with a Shimadzu DTG-60H scanning calorimeter (Shimadzu, Kyoto, Japan). The samples were heated using a closed alumina crucible with a perforated lid with a heating rate of 10 °C/min up to 400 °C under dry nitrogen purge (70 mL/min).
eventi.note: GW-5: secondo picco esotermico ad alta temperatura (360–370 °C), «decomposition and oxidation»; frase unica per le cinque forme (un evento per forma e per picco). Avviene sopra la fusione della stessa traccia. Crogiolo: «closed alumina crucible with a perforated lid» (numero di fori non detto).

citazioni: Therefore, storage in the climatic room where the polymorphs are exposed to a certain humidity and temperature regime (relative humidity of 75% and temperature of 40 °C) is necessary to investigate the stability.

The samples were kept for up to two months in the climatic chamber and X-ray diffraction patterns were recorded at certain time intervals (24 h, one week, two weeks, one month, and two months). In Figure S4 (Supporting Information) the comparisons between the patterns are presented. No significant changes were recorded over time, suggesting that the samples are stable and do not undergo phase transitions.
eventi.note: Stabilita' di GW-1 a 40 °C e 75% RH fino a due mesi (PXRD a 24 h, una settimana, due settimane, un mese e due mesi): «No significant changes were recorded over time». La frase dice «the polymorphs» / «the samples» senza elencarli: sono stati presi i quattro polimorfi riprodotti in quantita' (GW-1, GW-2, GW-3, GW-5); GW-4 non era riproducibile e non e' detto che sia stato incluso. Certezza bassa.

citazioni: To obtain new polymorphs, a screening was undertaken in a variety of solvents and solvent mixtures. GW501516 (10 mg) with a purity of 99% was dissolved in a wide range of solvents (1 mL) after which the solutions were heated to approximately 40 °C and were allowed to cool to 3 °C. The vials were covered with parafilm in which very small holes were made; the solvents were left to evaporate slowly for several weeks.
The recrystallization process of GW501516 in acetonitrile yielded the formation of the starting polymorph
(i)GW-1 (starting polymorph) from acetonitrile;
preparazioni.note: Protocollo di screening: 10 mg di GW501516 (purezza 99%) in 1 mL di solvente, soluzioni scaldate a circa 40 °C e lasciate raffreddare a 3 °C, in vial coperte da parafilm con piccoli fori, evaporazione lenta per «several weeks». Il testo non dice la temperatura a cui avviene l'evaporazione: nel campo si e' messa quella di arrivo del raffreddamento (3 °C). L'acetonitrile non e' nell'elenco dei solventi usati nello screening («The complete list of solvents used is the following ...»): incoerenza del testo.

The slow evaporation of GW501516 in a mixture of pentane and acetone yielded the formation of a new polymorph

The solvent mixtures used for polymorph screening were 1:1 volumetric ratios of 2,2,2-trifluoroethanol with tetrahydrofuran, methanol with tetrahydrofouran, ethyl acetate with dimethylformamide, chloroform with isopropyl alcohol, ethyl acetate with acetone, diisopropyl ether with acetic acid, and pentane with acetone.

Miscela pentano/acetone (rapporto 1:1 volumetrico fra quelli dello screening: «1:1 volumetric ratios of ... pentane with acetone»).

citazioni: (v)GW-4 was found in the bulk of the starting sample as single crystals but was not further reproduced.

The starting sample consists of a mixture of two polymorphs, namely GW-1 (which is found in the majority) and the minor phase (GW-4) which was selected for single-crystal diffraction analysis, but which was not reproduced further for another analysis.
preparazioni.note: GW-4 e' stato trovato come cristallo singolo nel campione di partenza (non da una cristallizzazione dello screening) e usato per la diffrazione.

citazioni: GW-4, found in the start probe, has always recrystallized centrosymmetrically upon dissolution and slow evaporation in various solvents. This is due to the lower overall lattice energy compared with the other polymorphs.

Furthermore, this is the reason why the polymorph GW-4 could not be reproduced by recrystallization, because the compound tends to pack into forms that have lower overall crystal lattice energy (such as GW-1, GW-2, or GW-3).
preparazioni.note: GW-4 non si riottiene per ricristallizzazione: «has always recrystallized centrosymmetrically upon dissolution and slow evaporation in various solvents»; gli autori lo attribuiscono alla minore energia reticolare di GW-4 rispetto agli altri polimorfi. Non e' un evento: le forme ottenute dipendono dal solvente (prep. di GW-1, GW-2, GW-3, GW-5).

preparazioni.pretrattamento: GW-1 e GW-2 sciolti in una miscela di etanolo e acqua, vial lasciate aperte 24 h per evaporare in parte il solvente
citazioni: Polymorphs GW-1 and GW-2 were dissolved in a mixture of ethanol and water and the vials were left open for 24 h, during which a part of the solvent evaporated. Following this, they were exposed to a temperature of −55 °C for two days, after which they underwent lyophilization.
preparazioni.note: Liofilizzazione per migliorare la solubilita' di GW-1 e GW-2 (non provata per gli altri polimorfi per mancanza di campione): dissoluzione in etanolo/acqua, 24 h a vial aperte, poi due giorni a −55 °C e liofilizzazione. Nel campo temperatura/tempo: il passaggio a −55 °C per due giorni; le 24 h di evaporazione sono nel pretrattamento. Le proporzioni della miscela etanolo/acqua non sono dette. La forma solida ottenuta non e' caratterizzata.

descrizioni.testo: high flexibility of the carbon-sulfur (C12)-(S2) bond at the methylsulfanyl group and, to a lesser extent, the C20-O1 bond between the acetate group and the phenoxy moiety
descrizioni.citazione: the ease of crystallizing in new polymorphs is mainly due to the high flexibility of the carbon-sulfur (C12)-(S2) bond at the methylsulfanyl group and the C20-O1 bond between the acetate group and phenoxy moiety.

descrizioni.testo: two-plane shape at the methylsulfanyl group
descrizioni.citazione: Its asymmetric unit contains one molecule which is built in a two-plane shape at the methylsulfanyl group (Figure 2a).

descrizioni.testo: twisted shape at the methylsulfanyl and acetate group
descrizioni.citazione: with one molecule in the asymmetric unit, which adopts a twisted shape at the methylsulfanyl and acetate group (Figure 3a).
